symptom: The endpoint works but does not appear in /docs/v3Doc.json.
cause: One of three things: the route has no .Name(...), swagger.generation.mode is unset in the active config, or the handler is not in the FX controllers group so its Routes() is never called.
steps: Check the route registration has .Name(...) — swagger generation keys off the route name and skips unnamed routes silently.
Check swagger.generation.mode is present in the config for the environment you are running. It is absent from all six reference configs, so a new service inherits the gap.
Confirm the handler is registered with fx.ResultTags(serverHandler.ServerControllersGroupTag) — if not, see the fx-missing-dependency playbook.
Run swagger_check, which reports which of the three is wrong.
watch_out: swagger_check verifies the preconditions; it does not generate the document. A pass means the route will appear next time the service boots, not that it appears now.
